title: The Infinitive and the Participles
subtitle: Rīdan, rīdende, geriden.
objectives: Master The Infinitive and the Participles.
Read and translate authentic Old English poetry and prose.

sections.heading: Content
sections.body: Infinitive: rīdan (to ride). Present participle: rīdende (riding). Past participle: geriden (ridden). The ge- prefix marks completed action (perfective aspect). The participles decline like adjectives when used attributively.
